item.title: Israeli attacks in Gaza have stepped up since halt in bombing in Iran
item.description: At least five Palestinians were killed in Israeli strikes on the Gaza Strip on May 17. Israel has stepped up attacks in Gaza in the weeks since halting its ​joint bombing ‌with the US in Iran. Netanyahu's government says Hamas fighters are tightening their grip on the strip. The devastated Palestinian territory has seen near-daily Israeli fire since the ceasefire between Israel and Hamas went into effect in October.

item.title: Most of the architects of October 7 attacks have been killed, says Netanyahu
item.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said Sunday that Israel is close to finishing a key war aim in Gaza: killing the planners of the October 7 attacks. The comments came after Israel said it had killed senior Hamas commander Ezzedine Al-Haddad in an airstrike, as its campaign against the group’s leadership continues.

item.title: War in the Middle East: Israel targets top Hamas leader in Gaza
item.description: An Israeli airstrike in Gaza on Friday targeted the leader of Hamas ’ military wing, Israeli officials said, but it wasn't immediately clear if Izz al-Din al-Haddad was killed or injured.

item.title: Middle East war live: Iran announces new body to manage Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Iran's top security body announced on Monday the formation of a new body to manage the Strait of Hormuz. Tehran said it had responded to a new US proposal aimed at ending the war, adding that talks with Washington via mediator Pakistan are ongoing. This comes after drone strikes were reported on US allies in the Gulf on Sunday, including Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.

item.title: Non-Jewish professor says he was fired for calling out Hamas supporters in online post
item.description: Canadian professor Paul Finlayson says he was fired for defending Israel on social media amid a wave of antisemitism following the Oct. 7 attacks.

item.title: Trump warns Iran that 'there won't be anything left of them' without peace deal
item.description: US President Donald Trump warned Iran on Sunday to move quickly towards a peace deal or face destruction, as Washington’s war with Tehran and its allies continues to stall negotiations, drive up energy prices and fuel instability across the Middle East.

item.title: Israel, Lebanon extending ceasefire, US says, despite new Israeli strikes
item.description: Israel and Lebanon agreed to extend a ceasefire and hold expanded talks on a political settlement, the US announced days before the April 17 ceasefire was set to expire. The announcement came even as Israel carried out new strikes in southern Lebanon that it insists are not subject to the truce. Israel has been pounding Lebanon and invaded its south in response to fire from Hezbollah since early March.

item.title: Middle East: Israel attacks south Lebanon day after ceasefire extension
item.description: Israel launched a massive series of airstrikes on southern Lebanon on Saturday, despite an extension of the truce between the two countries.

item.title: Leader of Hamas's armed wing killed in strike on Gaza, says Israel
item.description: The Israeli military said on Saturday that it had killed the head of Hamas's military wing Ezzedine Al-Haddad during an air strike carried out the previous day in Gaza. Haddad's wife and daughter were also killed in the attack, according to a Hamas source.

item.title: Israel strikes southern Lebanon hours after ceasefire extension
item.description: Israel launched new air strikes against Hezbollah in southern Lebanon on Saturday, hours after the two countries agreed to extend a truce following talks in the US. The April 17 ceasefire, which did not end Israeli strikes in Lebanese territory, will be extended for 45 days, said the US. Read about the day’s events as they unfolded on our liveblog.
